description: Verified exam notes for 13 November 2026 covering trade, astronomy outreach, telecom regulation, India–Sri Lanka defence cooperation, Census operations, UAPA, India–Italy research, medicine pricing, consumer protection and tuberculosis control.

stories.title: April–October total exports estimated at US$568.84 billion
stories.summary: The Commerce Ministry estimated India's combined merchandise and services exports at US$568.84 billion during April–October 2026-27, 16.66% higher than the corresponding period a year earlier. Merchandise exports were US$309.06 billion and services exports were estimated at US$259.78 billion. The release explicitly notes that October services figures are estimates because the latest RBI services data available were for September.
key_facts: Combined exports in October 2026 were estimated at US$89.99 billion, up 29.90% year-on-year.
October merchandise exports were US$49.47 billion, while merchandise imports were US$89.35 billion.
April–October combined imports were estimated at US$662.19 billion, leaving an overall trade deficit of US$93.35 billion.
Electronic-goods exports rose 62.70% year-on-year in October 2026 to US$6.64 billion.
stories.exam_link: Revise balance of trade, current account components, merchandise versus services trade, and the difference between provisional estimates and final official data.
stories.source_title: Ministry of Commerce and Industry: India's Foreign Trade, 13 November 2026

stories.title: COSMOS-Mysuru inaugurated as India's first LED dome planetarium
stories.summary: The Prime Minister inaugurated the COSMOS-Mysuru Planetarium in Karnataka and described it as India's first LED dome planetarium. The facility was developed with the involvement of the Indian Institute of Astrophysics and the University of Mysore. It is intended to support astronomy education and public engagement with science rather than serve as an astronomical observatory.
key_facts: The planetarium is located in Mysuru, Karnataka.
The Indian Institute of Astrophysics and the University of Mysore were among the institutions associated with its construction.
A planetarium simulates the night sky for education, while an observatory uses instruments to collect astronomical observations.
The inauguration took place on 13 November 2026.
stories.exam_link: Revise the distinction between planetariums and observatories, the role of the Indian Institute of Astrophysics, and major Indian space-science missions such as Chandrayaan-3 and Aditya-L1.
stories.source_title: Prime Minister's Office: Inauguration of COSMOS-Mysuru Planetarium, 13 November 2026

stories.title: TRAI reports enforcement against over 124,000 spam-linked telecom resources
stories.summary: TRAI released its quarterly update on action against unsolicited commercial communications for July–September 2026. Telecom service providers reported 1.529 million UCC complaints, of which 0.723 million were actionable. Enforcement included temporary barring, one-year disconnections, sender blacklisting and blocking of SMS headers.
key_facts: The national subscriber base stood at about 1.349 billion on 30 September 2026.
A total of 110,325 telecom resources were barred for 15 days for a first violation.
Another 13,777 resources were disconnected for one year for repeated violations.
TRAI reported 374 senders blacklisted for one year and 3,725 SMS headers blocked.
Consumers may use the TRAI DND app to set promotional preferences and report UCC.
stories.exam_link: Revise TRAI's statutory role under the TRAI Act, 1997, unsolicited commercial communications, telecom service providers and the purpose of the Do Not Disturb framework.
stories.source_title: TRAI quarterly highlights on unsolicited commercial communications, 13 November 2026

stories.title: Indian contingent departs for India–Sri Lanka exercise MITRA SHAKTI 2026
stories.summary: A 170-member Indian Defence Forces contingent departed for Sri Lanka for the 12th edition of Exercise MITRA SHAKTI. The bilateral exercise is scheduled at the Army Training School, Maduru Oya, from 13 to 26 November 2026. The departure is completed, while the training programme itself is scheduled across the stated dates.
key_facts: The Indian contingent is drawn mainly from a battalion of the Rajputana Rifles and also includes Indian Air Force personnel.
The exercise focuses on counter-terrorism operations in a semi-urban environment under a United Nations mandate.
MITRA SHAKTI is an annual bilateral exercise held alternately in India and Sri Lanka.
Training includes urban patrolling, convoy protection, area ambush and combined-arms operations.
stories.exam_link: Revise India–Sri Lanka relations, bilateral military exercises, interoperability and the role of United Nations mandates in peace-support and counter-terrorism training scenarios.
stories.source_title: Ministry of Defence: Indian contingent departs for MITRA SHAKTI 2026, 13 November 2026

stories.title: Goa announces self-enumeration schedule for Census 2027
stories.summary: The Directorate of Census Operations, Goa, announced that online self-enumeration for the Population Enumeration phase of Census 2027 would run from 16 to 30 November 2026. Field population enumeration is planned from 1 December 2026 to 4 January 2027, followed by a revisional round. These are scheduled census operations, not completed results.
key_facts: Goa's revisional round is scheduled from 5 to 9 January 2027.
The census reference time for Goa is 00:00 hours on 5 January 2027.
Self-enumeration is an optional digital route for residents to submit census information.
The Directorate of Census Operations works under the Office of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner, India.
stories.exam_link: Revise the Census Act, 1948, Union List responsibility for census, the Registrar General and Census Commissioner, and the distinction between enumeration dates and the reference date.
stories.source_title: Ministry of Home Affairs: Goa Census 2027 self-enumeration schedule, 13 November 2026

stories.title: MHA extends UAPA ban on Islamic Research Foundation
stories.summary: The Ministry of Home Affairs announced that it had extended the declaration of the Islamic Research Foundation as an unlawful association under the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act. The official release attributes the extension to alleged activities involving communal hostility, separatism and support for terrorism. The measure is an executive action under the statutory UAPA framework and remains subject to the procedures and safeguards prescribed by that law.
key_facts: The Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act was enacted in 1967.
Under Section 3 of the UAPA, the Central Government may declare an association unlawful by notification.
An unlawful-association declaration is reviewed through the statutory tribunal mechanism under the Act.
The extension was announced by the Ministry of Home Affairs on 13 November 2026.
stories.exam_link: Revise reasonable restrictions on associations under Article 19, the UAPA's unlawful-association framework and the role of a tribunal in reviewing a government notification.
stories.source_title: Ministry of Home Affairs: Extension of IRF ban under UAPA, 13 November 2026

stories.title: India and Italy envisage a joint research call for 2027
stories.summary: India and Italy concluded their second Science and Innovation Dialogue in Rome and discussed a joint call for research proposals in 2027. The call remains planned rather than launched. Proposed priority fields include artificial intelligence, high-performance computing and big data; clean technology, hydrogen and renewable energy; and advanced biotechnology and biomedical research.
key_facts: The bilateral science and technology agreement was first signed in 1978 and renewed in 2003.
India–Italy relations were elevated to a Strategic Partnership in 2023.
The Joint Strategic Action Plan covers 2025–2029.
More than 150 joint projects have been implemented through the Indo-Italian Executive Programme of Cooperation.
stories.exam_link: Revise India–Italy relations, strategic partnerships, science diplomacy, joint calls for proposals and the difference between an announced research call and a funded project.
stories.source_title: Ministry of Science and Technology: India–Italy scientific cooperation, 13 November 2026

stories.title: NPPA orders monitoring of revised prices for 137 anti-cancer drugs
stories.summary: The National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority directed State Drug Controllers to monitor Trade Margin Rationalisation for 137 non-scheduled anti-cancer drugs. Revised prices took effect on 9 November following a Gazette order dated 17 October. Manufacturers, sellers, hospitals and medical institutions must follow and display the updated price lists; violations may trigger overcharging proceedings.
key_facts: The measure covers 137 non-scheduled anti-cancer drugs.
Trade Margin Rationalisation seeks to limit excessive margins in the supply chain rather than place every drug under scheduled-price control.
State Drug Controllers were asked to submit action-taken reports by 16 November 2026.
Overcharging action may be taken under the Drugs (Prices Control) Order, 2013.
Updated prices are available through the Pharma Sahi Daam app and portal.
stories.exam_link: Revise NPPA, the Drugs (Prices Control) Order, scheduled and non-scheduled formulations, ceiling prices and trade-margin rationalisation.
stories.source_title: Department of Pharmaceuticals: Monitoring TMR on 137 anti-cancer drugs, 13 November 2026

stories.title: CCPA penalises Ola over misleading pre-ride payment prompts
stories.summary: The Central Consumer Protection Authority imposed a ₹10 lakh penalty on ANI Technologies, operator of Ola, and ordered it to discontinue pre-ride prompts seeking an extra payment described as a tip or add-on. The authority held that suggesting payment could improve the chance of faster ride confirmation was misleading, an unfair trade practice and a dark pattern.
key_facts: CCPA is established under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.
The direction covers prompts, pre-set amounts and interface designs seeking payment above the upfront fare before a journey is completed.
The order refers to the Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023.
Consumers may lodge complaints through the National Consumer Helpline number 1915.
stories.exam_link: Revise the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, the powers of CCPA, misleading advertisements, unfair trade practices and dark patterns in digital interfaces.
stories.source_title: CCPA: Penalty on Ola for pre-ride tip feature, 13 November 2026

stories.title: WHO report records 38% decline in India's TB mortality since 2015
stories.summary: The Health Ministry highlighted findings of the WHO Global Tuberculosis Report 2026 showing that India's estimated TB mortality rate fell 38% between 2015 and 2025, from 28 to 18 deaths per lakh population. It also reported a 94% treatment-success rate for drug-susceptible TB. These figures show progress but do not mean tuberculosis has been eliminated.
key_facts: The reported global decline in TB mortality over the comparison period was 35%.
The TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan has screened more than 25 crore people.
The campaign reported more than 11 crore chest X-rays and 3 crore molecular tests.
Nearly 15 lakh asymptomatic TB cases were detected through intensified screening.
In 2025, 67,933 Panchayats were declared TB-free under the programme's criteria.
stories.exam_link: Revise the National TB Elimination Programme, airborne transmission, molecular diagnosis, drug-sensitive versus drug-resistant TB and the role of WHO's annual global TB report.
stories.source_title: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare: India's TB mortality progress, 13 November 2026
